fixes_applied.description: Load model in float32 (added dtype=torch.float32 to from_pretrained). Underlying cause: transformers 5.x loads the checkpoint in its native fp16, but torch.linalg.eigh on CUDA does not implement 'Half'. Older transformers (which the authors used) loaded fp32 by default, so fp32 restores the authors' numerical path for the whitening/eigendecomposition rather than masking a real problem.
fixes_applied.original_error: NotImplementedError: "linalg_eigh_cuda" not implemented for 'Half' (store_matrices.py line 17, torch.linalg.eigh(Cov_gamma))
